{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Spain|Spanish Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
*5 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
*1 can of [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]]
*1 can of [[Cookbook:Condensed Milk|evaporated milk]] (large can)
*Caramel ice cream topping

==Instructions==
#Heat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|375°F]].
#Combine all ingredients except caramel topping in [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]]. Blend for 2 minutes.
#Place a thin layer of caramel topping on bottom of a round [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]]. Pour egg mixture on top of caramel topping.
#Place the smaller pie pan in a larger pan filled with enough water so that it comes about 1 inch up the side of the smaller pan. This will act as a [[Cookbook:Bain-marie|bain marie]] and stop the flan from burning.
#Place both pans in [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. Cook for 1 hour or until center is firm.
#Remove from oven and let cool.
#Place a round dish over the top of the smaller pan, and flip it over to unmold it. The flan can be served on the dish.
